# Launch Plan

Decided to launch Thursday morning with three people on support and weekend cover as on-call only. Announcement will be short with what is new, where to get help, and demo link near the top. Research found opens peak 8-11 AM, which fits a morning launch, and next is to write the email before Wednesday ends.

Goal: Decide how to run a small product launch this week

## Outline
- Decide how to run a small product launch this week
  - Launch Day
    - Monday too rushed
    - Friday low attention
    - Thursday morning launch
  - Support
    - Three on launch day
    - Weekend on-call only
  - Announcement
    - Max two paragraphs
    - Say what is new
    - Say where to get help
    - Demo link near top
    - Write email before Wednesday

## Decisions
- Launch Thursday morning while team is around
- Keep announcement to two paragraphs at most
- Include one clear sentence about what is new
- Run weekend support as on-call only
- Place demo link near the top

## To do
- Write short launch email to customers before Wednesday ends

- Opens peak between 8 AM and 11 AM local time, while clicks often peak between 8 PM and 9 PM.
Morning 8 AM to 11 AM is the most reliable window for opens, when people triage inboxes. Opens spike between 8 AM to 11 AM when people scan inboxes, clicks peak later around 8 PM to 9 PM when people have time to engage. Most studies suggest late morning around 9 AM to 11 AM is good for opens. For a small launch this week, send the main launch email Tuesday through Friday at 9 AM to 11 AM local time by timezone, and send a buying reminder at 7 PM to 9 PM. Friday at 7 AM showed a 0.138 percent conversion rate in one dataset, with Monday at 8 AM at 0.114 percent. Track clicks and revenue, not only opens, because Apple privacy protection inflates opens.
